story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Pelxa was started by a team of operators who'd spent years running content, ads and traffic at scale — and kept hitting the same problem: every part of the funnel lived in a different tool, with a different version of the truth.
So we built one. A platform where content, traffic and monetization all share the same data layer, the same tracking and the same definition of revenue. Partners stop guessing — and start growing.
